architectural_inferences.proposal: Lane/bit-position serialization inside each already-sequential round
architectural_inferences.axis: Current row carries all25x64 state bit positions in parallel, with two calls paired in each sliced cell. Round serialization alone has no remaining24x factor.
architectural_inferences.boundaries: Separating IO/caller rows avoids copying218 IO+64caller columns through every lane subrow. Exact memory,program,input/output and halt relations must bind these components.
architectural_inferences.lookup_trade: Serialize the1041 secure LogUp batches into fewer lanes over additional rows while preserving exact chi/xor/caller request census and noncancelling scope.
architectural_inferences.mask_trade: A naive matrix transpose can multiply mask offsets and erase OODS savings. A few-mask keyed state/shuffle relation or carefully aligned lane AIR is needed; current direct PCS mask cap is8.
architectural_inferences.floor_trade: 8x transpose raises Keccak log13 to16, matching shared R16 floor. 16x reaches existing caller tree max17, so caller commitment heights remain18. 25x raises those two caller trees by1; whole mixed FRI start21 remains dominated by native log20 until larger growth. This row-count comparison assumes maximum constraint degree/composition split do not increase; a new AIR must rederive the complete key.
architectural_inferences.area_trade: Ideal width/rows transpose approximately preserves base cells; extra state-link columns, lookup work, boundary binding and power-of-two padding are excluded. No proving-time claim.

architectural_inferences.facts: Scalar program has1124 main+156 interaction columns at log14 (8413live,16384padded rows). One row carries a doubling and up to4additions plus selected/after points.
architectural_inferences.trade: A several-row transition machine could reduce parallel point columns while staying near log16. Split/table/program/point custody and recurrence constraints must remain exact.

architectural_inferences.status: read-only source finding; requires new original proof geometry, not reinterpretation of saved proofs
architectural_inferences.facts: Generic Secp adapter requests current,previous,next for EVERY main column. Product and Linear configs explicitly ignore previous/next in BOTH arithmetic and lookup kernels; other stateless configs do as well.
architectural_inferences.trade: Derive reads from canonical typed kernels including all inverse guards. Update eager sample adapters, shapes and transcript consistently; do not simply delete saved proof samples.
